short: Last British monarch born outside Great Britain and the last to lead an army in battle.
full:
Ascending to the throne in 1727, George II presided over a period of significant military and imperial expansion, despite his own limited political vision. His early reign was dominated by the political mastery of Robert Walpole, but George's personal focus remained largely on military affairs and his native Hanover, which frequently drew British resources into continental European conflicts.

He was the last British sovereign to fight alongside his troops, leading them at the Battle of Dettingen in 1743. His reign weathered the final and most serious Jacobite challenge in 1745, and concluded amidst the triumph of the Seven Years' War, which definitively secured British dominance in North America and India.
